description: OpenAI-compatible chat completions on Meta Llama 3.2 3B, a tiny, very cheap model for classification, extraction and simple chat (80K context). Set your OpenAI SDK base URL to https://agentrxi.com/v1/llama3b and pay per token with x402 instead of an API key: $0.153 per million input and $1.005 per million output tokens, minimum $0.002 a call, at most $0.0088. The 402 quotes your request's maximum; "upto" payers are charged only the tokens used. Same request/response shape as OpenAI (streaming supported), up to 4096 output tokens. Costs $0.0088 USDC per call (x402).
name: llama3b_chat_completions
